trainable: independent call-head query projection only; fixed key, backbone, LoRA and deployed discard head
selection: maximum validation macro-F1 averaged over three views, then minimum validation NLL, earliest tie
test_policy: single frozen selected candidate only; no checkpoint selection on test
primary_gameplay_metric: paired full-East net points versus confirmed calibration-02
deployment: no automatic replacement; require independent strength and legal-action regression checks
privacy: raw expert/simulation records, features and gradient diagnostics remain private
